data_objects.name: cyclone_track_metadata
data_objects.meaning: A row-oriented table of time-stamped cyclone track points, associated intensity and quality fields, a cyclone identifier, and a relative reference to an infrared HDF5 frame.

data_objects.name: infrared_brightness_temperature_frames
data_objects.meaning: A collection of per-time HDF5 rasters. Representative files contain one 512 by 512 floating-point array named /Infrared whose embedded long_name is Brightness temperature.

variables.name: year
variables.meaning: Calendar year component of the track-point timestamp.

variables.name: month
variables.meaning: Calendar month component of the track-point timestamp.

variables.name: day
variables.meaning: Calendar day component of the track-point timestamp.

variables.name: hour
variables.meaning: Hour-of-day component of the track-point timestamp, encoded from 0 through 23.

variables.name: grade
variables.meaning: Coded cyclone intensity grade; observed public values are 0, 2, 3, 4, and 5, but their category definitions are not embedded.

variables.name: lat
variables.meaning: Latitude of the cyclone track point.

variables.name: lng
variables.meaning: Longitude of the cyclone track point; observed values include longitudes greater than 180 degrees.

variables.name: pressure
variables.meaning: Pressure measurement associated with the cyclone track point.

variables.name: wind
variables.meaning: Wind measurement associated with the cyclone track point.

variables.name: dir50
variables.meaning: Direction-code field in the group labeled 50; it is constant at 9 in the public table and the code definition is not embedded.

variables.name: long50
variables.meaning: Long-extent field in the group labeled 50; it is constant at 0 in the public table.

variables.name: short50
variables.meaning: Short-extent field in the group labeled 50; it is constant at 0 in the public table.

variables.name: dir30
variables.meaning: Direction-code field in the group labeled 30; it is constant at 9 in the public table and the code definition is not embedded.

variables.name: long30
variables.meaning: Long-extent field in the group labeled 30; it is constant at 0 in the public table.

variables.name: short30
variables.meaning: Short-extent field in the group labeled 30; it is constant at 0 in the public table.

variables.name: landfall
variables.meaning: Landfall-status field; it is constant at 0 in the public table and the code definition is not embedded.

variables.name: intp
variables.meaning: Interpolation-status indicator. Its timing pattern is consistent with 1 marking temporally interpolated hourly records and 0 marking source-time records.

variables.name: mask
variables.meaning: Count-like mask amount associated with a frame; mask_pct equals this value divided by the 512 by 512 raster cell count within CSV rounding.

variables.name: mask_pct
variables.meaning: Masked-cell fraction associated with a frame, encoded from 0 to 1 despite the pct suffix.

variables.name: id
variables.meaning: Six-digit cyclone identifier used to group repeated track points and to name the corresponding image subdirectory.

variables.name: hdf_full_path
variables.meaning: Relative path intended to identify the HDF5 infrared frame for the same cyclone and timestamp.

variables.name: /Infrared
variables.meaning: A 512 by 512 float64 raster of brightness temperature; representative HDF5 files expose it as a compressed CArray with embedded long_name Brightness temperature.

variables.name: /Infrared axis 0
variables.meaning: First raster index axis of length 512; no coordinate values, orientation, or spatial unit are embedded.

variables.name: /Infrared axis 1
variables.meaning: Second raster index axis of length 512; no coordinate values, orientation, or spatial unit are embedded.

structure.description: The metadata table contains 10,347 repeated track-point rows across 58 cyclone IDs. The observed combination of id, year, month, day, and hour is unique, while each id relates to many time-stamped rows.
Image files are partitioned into cyclone-ID subdirectories. Observed filenames begin with a ten-digit YYYYMMDDHH timestamp, repeat the cyclone ID, include an HMW8 or HMW9 tag, and end in HDF5 format.

hdf_full_path provides the row-to-frame link. The public directory contains 8,279 HDF5 files, each referenced by one metadata row; 2,068 additional metadata path values do not resolve to a public file, so the relationship is one-to-zero-or-one from metadata rows to available frames.

Representative HDF5 files from the collection share a single /Infrared dataset with shape 512 by 512 and float64 storage. No latitude grid, longitude grid, time coordinate, fill value, or other raster-level coordinate variable is embedded in those files.

uncertainties: The CSV provides no embedded data dictionary or unit metadata. Pressure, wind, and the 30/50 direction and extent families therefore retain unknown units and partly unknown semantics.
The meanings of grade codes, direction code 9, landfall code 0, and the exact intp coding convention are not explicitly defined; intp is interpreted only from its name and hourly pattern.
The 30/50 extent fields are uniformly zero and their direction fields are uniformly 9, so it is unclear whether these are meaningful constants, unavailable measurements, or sentinel encodings.
The physical phenomenon represented by mask is not named. Only its numerical relationship to mask_pct and the raster cell count is established.
The timestamp time standard or time zone is not stated, and the longitude wrapping convention is not documented.

The metadata track-point latitude and longitude do not establish the raster pixel geolocation, center registration, resolution, footprint, or axis orientation because those raster coordinates are absent.
The meanings of the HMW8/HMW9 filename tags and the trailing numeric filename component are not embedded in the public artifacts.
The public table has no blank fields, but no explicit missing-value or sentinel-value policy is supplied. Representative infrared arrays have no declared fill-value attribute.
Of the metadata references that lack public HDF5 counterparts, all rows dated 2020 are affected along with 41 rows dated 2021; their intended image contents cannot be inspected.
annotation_notes: This task-independent map uses only the public CSV, the public image inventory, and bounded representative inspection of HDF5 contents.
HDF5 array name, shape, dtype, long_name, and kelvin unit come from embedded file metadata; interpretations of CSV fields are limited to names, encodings, and consistent value patterns.
